sentences.en: I am determined to make a living as a playwright.
sentences.zh: 我决心靠当剧作家谋生。

sentences.en: A student visited the house of the great playwright.
sentences.zh: 一名学生参观了这位伟大剧作家的故居。

sentences.en: The playwright cherishes the vivid memories of his childhood.
sentences.zh: 那位剧作家珍视他童年时代的生动回忆。
